title: Eigenvalue Estimates of the Hodge Laplacian Under Lower Ricci Curvature Bound
summary: We establish uniform lower and upper bounds for the eigenvalues of the Hodge Laplacian acting on differential forms on closed Riemannian manifolds with a lower Ricci curvature bound, a positive lower bound on the injectivity radius, and an upper bound on the diameter. Our results extend earlier work of Dodziuk, Lott, and Mantuano, which required bounded sectional curvature, to the broader setting of lower Ricci curvature bounds.
